title: Global Regularity for the 3D Incompressible Navier–Stokes Equations via the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether: Lean 4 Formalization and Conditional Cubic Comparison Framework (v2.1)
description: Lean 4 formalization (360 kernel-verified theorems across 14 modules, 0 sorry, only standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and 19-page companion manuscript establishing a verified non-vacuous conditional reduction for 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes global regularity via the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether. Proves that Kato local existence (with uniform restart length), physical-solution uniqueness (IsPhysicalNSSolution), and the cubic tether rate M'(t) <= C_CZ M(t)^2 - kappa'' M(t)^3 imply the global vorticity ceiling M(t) <= max(M(0), C_CZ / kappa'') and global smooth continuation (frohmanian_tether_theorem, global_regularity_for_NS), with joint satisfiability and non-vacuity certified unconditionally at u_0 = 0 (global_regularity_for_NS_nonvacuous_at_zero) and all original conjectured bridges preserved without sorry.
